title: Reading the Historiographical -ra Form
goal: Recognise indicative-value -ra in plaques, obituaries and historical essays and distinguish it from true subjunctive -ra.
grammar: Stylistic indicative -ra vs true subjunctive -ra in historical prose

items: I can interpret the formal indicative *-ra* form (*que albergara*, *como señalara*) in plaques, obituaries and historical essays.
I can distinguish factual indicative *-ra* (where *-se* is excluded) from true subjunctive *-ra* within the same historical text.
I can use commemorative vocabulary (*la placa*, *la inscripción*, *la semblanza*, *la efeméride*) accurately.
